title: Direct Knowledge Of Allah 19th Degree 1st Truth The Manifestations Of Dominicality And Divinity

questions.question: What do the many acts of care and mercy in the passage point to?
questions.answer: They point to Allah’s necessary existence and His oneness.

questions.question: Besides deeds, what two other things in the passage also give proof about Allah?
questions.answer: The many Divine Names and the seven high attributes also give proof.

questions.question: What do the beauty and excellence seen in created things show?
questions.answer: They show higher beauty and perfection in Allah’s actions, Names, attributes, and His pure Essence.

questions.question: In this passage, what does the truth of dominicality make known through its actions?
questions.answer: It makes known Allah’s Lordship through acts like creating, shaping, planning, changing, feeding, and caring.

questions.question: Which pair of qualities is linked with creating and bringing things into existence?
questions.answer: Knowledge and wisdom.

questions.question: Which pair of qualities is connected with measuring, shaping, and managing things in order?
questions.answer: Regularity and balance.

questions.question: Which pair of qualities is connected with changing, sending down, and completing things?
questions.answer: Purpose and will.

questions.question: Which pair of qualities is connected with feeding and giving blessings?
questions.answer: Tenderness and mercy.

questions.question: Through what does the truth of Divinity become clearly recognized in this passage?
questions.answer: Through the kind and generous appearances of the Beautiful Names and the glorious and beautiful appearances of the seven attributes.

questions.question: Name the seven attributes mentioned at the end of the passage.
questions.answer: Life, Knowledge, Power, Will, Hearing, Sight, and Speech.

questions.question: If someone sees order, mercy, and wise care in the world, what should he understand from this passage?
questions.answer: He should understand that these signs lead to Allah, Who is one and has perfect attributes.

questions.question: What is a main idea of the whole passage?
questions.answer: Everything in creation points to Allah’s Lordship, His Names, His attributes, and His oneness.

questions.question: According to the passage, do the many Divine deeds give only one proof or many proofs about Allah?
questions.answer: They give countless proofs about Allah.

questions.question: What central belief do these proofs support?
questions.answer: They support that Allah truly exists and that He is one.

questions.question: The passage says the Divine Names come from the deeds. What comes from the Names?
questions.answer: The seven transcendent attributes are shown through the Names.

questions.question: How are beauty and perfection in created things used as evidence in the passage?
questions.answer: They act like signs that point to perfect beauty and excellence belonging to Allah in a way fitting for Him.

questions.question: What kinds of actions show the truth of dominicality first?
questions.answer: Actions like making, inventing, shaping, and bringing things into being.

questions.question: What qualities go with those first actions?
questions.answer: Knowledge and wisdom.

questions.question: What actions in the passage show control and arrangement?
questions.answer: Measuring, forming, directing, and changing things.

questions.question: What actions show choice and intention?
questions.answer: Transforming, sending down, and completing things.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the way Divinity is recognized?
questions.answer: It is recognized right away through the Beautiful Names and the seven attributes.

questions.question: What three levels of signs are mentioned at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: Deeds, Divine Names, and sacred attributes.

questions.question: What do all three levels agree on?
questions.answer: They all testify to Allah’s existence and unity.

questions.question: What in creation also gives evidence besides actions and names?
questions.answer: The beauty, loveliness, perfection, and fine design in created things also give evidence.

questions.question: What do these good qualities in creation tell us about Allah’s deeds?
questions.answer: They show that His deeds are beautiful and perfect in a holy and fitting way.

questions.question: What does “dominicality” mean here in a simple way?
questions.answer: It means Allah’s Lordship shown by how He creates, controls, cares for, and provides for everything.

questions.question: Which actions in the passage show that Allah brings things into existence with wisdom?
questions.answer: Creating, originating, shaping, and giving existence.

questions.question: Which actions show management with order?
questions.answer: Measuring, forming, directing, and changing.

questions.question: Which actions show mercy in taking care of creation?
questions.answer: Feeding, nurturing, giving generously, and granting blessings.

questions.question: What truth is found within the manifestation of dominicality?
questions.answer: The truth that Divinity is clearly being revealed.

questions.question: How is this revelation of Divinity shown?
questions.answer: It is shown through the Beautiful Names and the seven affirming attributes.

questions.question: Which of the seven attributes would help us understand that Allah hears every dua?
questions.answer: Hearing.

questions.question: Which of the seven attributes would help us understand that Allah chooses with purpose?
questions.answer: Will.

questions.question: According to the passage, what do endless signs in the world testify about the One behind them?
questions.answer: They testify that Allah exists necessarily, is one, and possesses perfect attributes.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention both deeds and Names?
questions.answer: Because the deeds show Allah’s working in creation, and the Names show the meanings behind those deeds.

questions.question: What do the many examples of beauty in creation point upward to?
questions.answer: They point upward to the holy beauty and perfection of Allah’s actions, Names, attributes, and Essence.

questions.question: What is one example of Allah’s Lordship shown in the passage?
questions.answer: One example is that He feeds and raises His creation with mercy.

questions.question: What is another example of Allah’s Lordship shown in the passage?
questions.answer: Another example is that He shapes and manages things with order and balance.

questions.question: What do creating and designing with wisdom teach us about Allah?
questions.answer: They teach us that His actions are full of knowledge and wisdom.

questions.question: What do steady order and balance in change teach us?
questions.answer: They teach us that change is under Allah’s control, not random.

questions.question: What do giving food and blessings teach us about Allah?
questions.answer: They teach us that He is caring, generous, and merciful.

questions.question: What two ways of Divine self-disclosure are named at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: The compassionate and generous display of the Beautiful Names, and the glorious and beautiful display of the seven attributes.

questions.question: Which attribute would help us understand that Allah knows all things?
questions.answer: Knowledge.

questions.question: Which attribute would help us understand that Allah can do all things?
questions.answer: Power.

questions.question: In the passage, what is the source of the many dominical and merciful deeds?
questions.answer: They come from the manifestations of Allah’s Divine Names.

questions.question: What is said to be the source of the Beautiful Names?
questions.answer: The seven transcendent attributes are described as their source.

questions.question: What do these layers of evidence finally point to?
questions.answer: They point to Allah, the glorious Essence, Who has those attributes.

questions.question: How does the passage use the beauty of created things as a proof?
questions.answer: It says that the goodness and fine beauty in creation point to higher beauty and perfection belonging to Allah.

questions.question: What four actions are grouped together with knowledge and wisdom?
questions.answer: Bringing into existence, originating, shaping, and creating.

questions.question: What four actions are grouped together with order and balance?
questions.answer: Measuring, forming, directing, and changing.

questions.question: What three actions are grouped together with purpose and will?
questions.answer: Transforming, sending down, and perfecting.

questions.question: What three actions are grouped together with tenderness and mercy?
questions.answer: Feeding, nurturing, and giving generously.

questions.question: If the world is full of provision and care, what does the passage say this should make us recognize?
questions.answer: It should make us recognize Allah’s Lordship and His merciful Divinity.

questions.question: What are the seven affirmative attributes named in the passage?
questions.answer: Life, Knowledge, Power, Will, Hearing, Sight, and Speech.

questions.question: What is the relationship between dominicality and Divinity in the passage?
questions.answer: Lordship is seen in Allah’s actions in the world, and through that, His Divinity becomes known and recognized.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number of ways the signs point to Allah?
questions.answer: It says they point in endless and unlimited ways.

questions.question: What two big truths about Allah are proven by these signs?
questions.answer: That He truly exists and that He is one.

questions.question: What features in created things are mentioned as signs of deeper realities?
questions.answer: Their beauty, loveliness, perfection, and fine workmanship.

questions.question: What deeper realities do those features point to?
questions.answer: They point to the holy beauty and perfection of Allah’s deeds, Names, attributes, qualities, and pure Essence.

questions.question: What truth appears within ongoing Divine activity?
questions.answer: The truth of dominicality appears within that activity.

questions.question: What truth appears within the manifestation of dominicality?
questions.answer: The truth of Divinity appears within it.

questions.question: Which actions in the passage show that Allah makes things from the start?
questions.answer: Creating, originating, fashioning, and bringing into being.

questions.question: Which actions show that Allah runs creation in an organized way?
questions.answer: Determining, forming, administering, and changing.

questions.question: Which actions show that Allah deals with creation gently and generously?
questions.answer: Feeding, nurturing, and giving bounty.

questions.question: Through what does Divinity become known in a direct and clear way?
questions.answer: Through the merciful signs of the Beautiful Names and the glorious signs of the seven attributes.

questions.question: Which attribute would help you understand that Allah speaks to His creation in a way fitting for Him?
questions.answer: Speech.

questions.question: What is the best summary of this passage in one sentence?
questions.answer: The ordered, wise, beautiful, and merciful world shows Allah’s Lordship, His perfect Names and attributes, and His absolute oneness.
